artifacts.content:
STATE: H : History
AXIOM: A = H
INV: H.authoritative_causal_record
INV: H.reproducible
INV: H.inspectable
INV: H.derivable
INV: EventABI !in H
INV: ResolutionSemantics !in H
EXCLUDE: EventABI, Resolution, SemanticUnit, Interpretation, LLMRuntime

STATE: H : History, M : ProjectionModel, J : JustificationStructure, A : History
OP: d(H) -> M, j(M) -> J
AXIOM: A = H
AXIOM: M = d(H)
AXIOM: J = j(M)
AXIOM: G(J, H)
INV: d.deterministic
INV: j.derived_exclusively_from(d)
INV: d.semantically_neutral
INV: d.reproducible
EXCLUDE: EventABI, Resolution, SemanticUnit, Interpretation, Knowledge, LLMRuntime

STATE: H : History, M : ProjectionModel, ABI : EventABI, S : SemanticModel, J : JustificationStructure, A : History
OP: interpret(M, ABI) -> S, justify(S) -> J
AXIOM: A = H
AXIOM: M = projection(H)
AXIOM: S = interpret(M, ABI)
AXIOM: J = justify(S)
INV: interpret.deterministic_under(ABI)
INV: ABI.explicit_and_versioned
INV: S.derived_exclusively_from(M)
INV: interpret.preserves_order(M)
INV: J.derived_exclusively_from(S)
INV: external_semantic_injection !in interpret
INV: S.non_authoritative
EXCLUDE: ProjectionGeneration, KnowledgeGeneration, Analysis, FullSemanticReasoning, WorldModeling, ExecutionSemantics, GraphConstruction, RuntimeEvaluation, CanonicalStateMutation

STATE: H : History, M : ProjectionModel, S : SemanticModel, G : RelationalGraph
OP: graph(S) -> G
AXIOM: G = graph(S)
AXIOM: H -> M -> S -> G
AXIOM: T(G)
INV: graph.deterministic_from(S)
INV: nodes.preserve_identity_consistency
INV: edges.structural_relations_only
INV: traversal.deterministic
INV: interpretation !in G
INV: G.non_authoritative
EXCLUDE: SemanticInterpretation, EventABIProcessing, ObservationSemantics, MeaningAttribution, ExternalWorldBinding, KnowledgeGeneration, RuntimeExecution

observed_relationships.rationale: These specifications define sequential dependencies within the Delta3 Kernel's IR pipeline. Phase C produces the SemanticModel (S) required by Phase D to generate the RelationalGraph (G). Merging them would violate separation of concerns between semantic interpretation and structural graph topology generation.

Phase A establishes the immutable causal record and exclusion of interpretive logic. Phase C defines how interpretation (S) and justification (J) are deterministically derived from History via ABI without compromising authority. Both specs are essential for Delta3 Kernel's layered integrity.

Doc A establishes the structural projection layer (Phase B), while Doc B introduces the semantic interpretation layer via ABI (Phase C). Both are necessary to define the complete transformation from History to Semantic Justification within the Chron-LLM architecture.

These documents define separate architectural contracts for different pipeline stages within the Delta3 Kernel. Phase B establishes the foundational projection logic (H->M), while Phase D governs graph topology generation (S->G). Maintaining them separately preserves clear phase boundaries, invariant isolation, and modular verification capabilities.
Distinct phase charters required for Delta3 Kernel layering; merging obscures the boundary between raw history recording (A) and derived projection logic (B).
